title: Evidence persistence: inert immutable pack storage, witnesses and keyed views for full-evidence exchange
outcome: Evidence persistence: inert immutable pack storage, witnesses and keyed views for full-evidence exchange
acceptance: Immutable evidence packs and their records are retained transactionally in a new storage/work/task_sync/evidence subtree, inert: retained records grant no destination credit and change no live claim, session or run. Exact replay is a no-op; same id with different kind or bytes refuses atomically; a failure rolls back with no partial retention.

Origin-qualified feed segment/cut and governing-snapshot witnesses are retained outside destination native feeds per the accepted design (w-09c87a312e95 notes 7a94378a and 31a28eee), with behavior tests for gap, beyond-cut and changed-membership refusal.

Keyed evidence views and bounded resumable batches read changed objects without scanning or reloading history on normal deltas or replay, and enforce the accepted limits with typed oversize outcomes; no record is truncated.
Shared ledger, reducer, view, data-worktree and service wiring stay on w-7413b4728667 and w-4eabb205c7b2; this item's part of them is an agreed seam only.
